'''Phil Aasen''' is a member of [[Team 5]]<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref> and the 2017 World Champion. He played the [[2026 San Diego Super Open]].<ref name="pc-sdso">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-04-san-diego-super-open-san-diego-california-apr-11-to-12-2026/ 2026-04 San Diego Super Open], starwarsccg.org</ref>
